verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a research agent that chains search tools within a session, plus a REST API and MCP server that developers can call to run automated searches. Those are interactive features and developer building blocks, not product-native automations that a user sets up to run on a schedule or autonomously in the background. Nothing in the pack documents recurring jobs, scheduled searches, alerts, or background execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: run automated searches with our API to quickly and easily find the most relevant and reliable research
Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.
Power agent workflows that need citable scientific sources via the REST API or MCP server
